# sqlite_ffi

**Raw** SQLite C ABI bindings generated by `cpc-bindgen` from `sqlite3.h`.

- Not for application use.
- No ownership, `str`, or `Result` ergonomics — handles are `*u8`, paths are `*i8`.
- Linked as system `libsqlite3`.

Use the hand-written **`sqlite`** package instead.

```toml
# prefer:
[dependencies]
sqlite = "*"
```

Regenerate (do not hand-edit `src/sqlite.cplus`):

```
cpc-bindgen --cpackage --out vendor/sqlite_ffi --header <sdk>/usr/include/sqlite3.h --clib sqlite3 -- -isysroot <sdk>
```
